statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-5199 was introduced upstream in Temporal Server v1.29.0 and later fixed in v1.29.5 and v1.30.3. This VEX applies only to the 1.28.4 server packages shipped in this image: that release line predates the vulnerable batch activity implementation entirely, so the affected code was never present in these binaries.
